propositions: A standing eval spec for the concurrency overlay must be authored to prevent silent regression in recall/precision behavior established by a traced-bug corpus.

The spec must define scored gating dataset entries including at least 2 recall cases (unlocked-twin and TOCTOU) and at least 3 no-fire cases, each distilled as minimal diff hunks with commit-level provenance comments.
R3 (fail-open guard) must be present as a non-gating documented stretch case (commented hunk block) rather than a scored case, so it cannot fail the gate despite being known-hard.
The spec must use 3 epochs with deterministic scorers and gate at_least(2), enforcing all-or-nothing per-epoch passage and coverage_threshold as a run-success floor only.
The file must pass validation via rebar prompt eval code-review-concurrency exit code and the packaged-spec discipline gate (unique ids, known expect vocabulary, balanced fire/pass dataset).
